The '''1977–78 Serie A''' season was won by [[Juventus FC|Juventus]].

==Teams==
[[Vicenza Calcio|Vicenza]], [[Atalanta BC|Atalanta]] and [[Pescara Calcio|Pescara]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
